title: Safe Deposit Boxes: which rental receives the checking relationship discount
content:
## Scope

This policy covers the relationship discount on Safe Deposit Boxes rent: the discount a customer earns by holding an active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account, and which of the customer's box rentals it is allocated to.

## Policy clause

Rent discounts are allocated across the customer's rentals, not per box. Holding an active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account earns the relationship discount on one rental only. That rental is the customer's active or past due rental with the highest annual rent before discount; where rentals tie on that amount, the rental with the earliest lease start date is the one.

## Relationship discount rates

| Official box size | Active Premier Checking held | Active Private Client Checking held |
|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent |

The rate is read from the row for the size of the rental that receives the relationship discount and the column for the checking tier held.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** whether the customer holds an active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account; the customer's rentals with their status, annual rent before discount and lease start date.
- **Judgement:** keep only rentals that are active or past due; take the one with the highest annual rent before discount; if two or more share that highest amount, take the one whose lease started earliest.
- **Output:** that single rental earns the relationship discount, at the rate for its box size and the checking tier held. No other rental of the customer earns it.

## Hypothetical cases

All amounts and dates below are invented for illustration.

- **Case 1.** A customer holds active Premier Checking, an active 3x5 box with a hypothetical annual rent before discount of $70.00, and an active 10x10 box with a hypothetical $180.00. The 10x10 rental has the higher rent, so it earns the relationship discount, at 25 percent. The 3x5 rental earns none, even though its own Premier Checking rate of 50 percent is larger.
- **Case 2.** A customer holds active Private Client Checking and two active 5x10 boxes, each with a hypothetical annual rent before discount of $120.00, one leased on 3 March 2018 and one on 9 May 2021. The rents tie, so the rental leased on 3 March 2018 earns the discount, at 50 percent.
- **Case 3.** A customer holds active Premier Checking, a past due 3x10 box and a drill pending 10x20 box. Only active or past due rentals are eligible, so the 3x10 rental earns the discount, at 50 percent.

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| Each box the customer rents gets the relationship discount. | It is earned on one rental only. |
| The discount goes to the box where its percent would be largest. | It goes to the active or past due rental with the highest annual rent before discount. |
| A tie is broken by the newest lease. | A tie goes to the earliest lease start date. |
